words.zh: n. 生理机能，生理学；【生】生理学
words.example: Understanding human physiology helps doctors know how the body works.

words.zh: adj. 关键的，至关重要的；决定性的
words.example: Regular exercise plays a crucial role in maintaining good health.

words.zh: n. 瘴气；疟疾
words.example: The invention of artemisinin has saved millions of people from malaria.

words.zh: adj. 必不可少的，至关重要的；有活力的；生死攸关的；生命的；  n. 重要部分，要害
words.example: Clean water is vital for the survival of all living creatures.

words.zh: adj. 效忠的；忠于……的；坚信的；坚定的，尽心尽力的；  v. commit的过去式
words.example: The committed scientist spent years searching for a new medicine.

words.zh: v. 犯（罪）；进行 (自杀)；调拨 (钱、资源)；监禁；送交 (到精神病院、监狱等)；干（坏事）；委托，托付；承诺，保证；致力于；用纸记下；书写
words.example: Anyone who commits a crime will be punished by law.

words.zh: v. 犯（罪）；进行 (自杀)；调拨 (钱、资源)；监禁；送交 (到精神病院、监狱等)；干（坏事）；委托，托付；承诺，保证；致力于；用纸记下；书写
words.example: She committed herself to finishing the research before the deadline.

words.zh: n. 学院；学会；研究院；私立中学；学术
words.example: The young pianist was accepted into the music academy in Shanghai.

words.zh: adj. 学术的；学院的；理论的；  n. 学者；学科
words.example: Her academic performance improved greatly after she joined the study group.

words.zh: n. 目标；  adj. 客观的；真实的；（语法）宾格的；公正的
words.example: The main objective of the experiment is to test the new theory.

words.zh: adj. 植物（学）的
words.example: The botanical garden contains thousands of rare plants from around the world.

words.zh: v. 评估；评价；估计；【计】求值；【数】求值
words.example: Teachers evaluate students' progress through tests and classroom performance.

words.zh: n. 房产；财产；特性；性能；财物；【计】属性；房地产行业，不动产（=real estate ）；【化】特质，特性；【航】特性
words.example: This rare plant has medicinal properties that scientists are still studying.

words.zh: adj. 截然不同的；独特的；明显的；清晰的；确切的，确定无误的
words.example: The two species are distinct and cannot produce offspring together.

words.zh: v. 取出；提取；摘录；设法得到；索取（读作/ɪkˈstrækt/）；【化】提取，萃取；  n. 摘录；提出物（读作/ˈɛksˌtrækt/）
words.example: The scientist extracted a yellow liquid from the leaves of the plant.

words.zh: v. 烧开，煮沸，沸腾；用开水煮，在沸水中煮；怒火中烧，异常气愤；【化】煮沸，沸腾，达到沸点；【物】沸腾；  n. 煮沸，沸腾；疔，疖子；【医】疡肿，脓肿
words.example: You should boil the water before drinking it in the wilderness.

words.zh: n. 液体；流体；【化】液体；【物】液体；  adj. 液体的，液态的；清脆的
words.example: Water is a liquid that is essential for all known life.

words.zh: v. 获得，赢得，取得；存在，流行，适用；形成；【化】获得，得到
words.example: Students can obtain useful information from reliable sources online.

words.zh: vt. 承认；感谢；（公开）致谢；致意；认可；告知收到
words.example: The author acknowledged the help of her teacher in the book's preface.

words.zh: v. 打败，击败，战胜；  n. 击败，战胜；挫败
words.example: The team worked together to defeat the defending champions in the final.

words.zh: v. 分析，分解
words.example: We need to analyse the results carefully before drawing any conclusion.

words.zh: adv. 显然；看来，似乎；据说
words.example: Apparently, the experiment failed because of a small measurement error.

words.zh: n. 物质；实质；资产；主旨；物品；【化】物质；【物】物质
words.example: Scientists discovered a new substance that can kill bacteria quickly.

words.zh: v. 坚持；坚持要求；坚持认为；坚持认为...
words.example: The doctor insists that patients take their medicine at the same time.

words.zh: phr. 坚持，强调，坚决要求，督促
words.example: She insisted on finishing the experiment even though it was late.

words.zh: adj. 科学的
words.example: Scientific research has greatly improved our understanding of diseases.

words.zh: adv. 大多；主要地；一般地；通常
words.example: The students in this class are mostly interested in science and technology.

words.zh: phr. 磨损
words.example: This machine shows signs of wear and tear after years of use.

words.zh: n. 结论，推论；总结，归纳；结束，结局；【数】结论
words.example: After long observation, the biologist drew a conclusion about the birds' behavior.

words.zh: v. 逃走；逃离；避开；迅速离开
words.example: Many families had to flee their homes because of the severe flood.

words.zh: n. 情况；条件；客观环境；处境；环境
words.example: In this special circumstance, we must make a quick decision.

words.zh: n. 小说家
words.example: The young novelist wrote a moving story about village life.

words.zh: n. 小说，长篇故事；  adj. 新奇的，新颖的
words.example: She read a novel during the summer vacation and found it fascinating.

words.zh: v. 流动；飘垂；涨潮；来自……的结果；流畅；使泛滥；流；持续抵达；持续供应（或生产）；（人，物）涌向，涌进；【化】流动；  n. 流动；流通；流量
words.example: The river flows gently through the valley into the lake.

words.zh: v. 记录，跟踪（变化或进展）；  vt. 制成图表；制航海图；  n. 图表，表格；航海图；每周排行榜；【化】图表；【数】图表，图形
words.example: The nurse charted the patient's temperature every four hours.

words.zh: phr. 流程图；作业图；生产过程图解
words.example: The flow chart shows the steps of the science experiment clearly.

words.zh: v. 成立，建立，创办；发现，感到（find的过去式）；把……建立在；发现，找到；创立，创建
words.example: The school was founded by a famous educator in 1908.

words.zh: v. 推断；暗示；【计】推导
words.example: From the evidence, we can infer that the ancient city had a market.

words.zh: n. 政治家，政客
words.example: The young politician gave a speech about education reform at the town hall.

words.zh: adj. 为数众多的，许多的
words.example: She has read numerous novels about space exploration and scientific discovery.

words.zh: n. 理论，原理；学说；推测；想法；【化】理论，学说
words.example: The theory of evolution explains how species change over time.

words.zh: n. 相关性；相对性；相对论
words.example: Einstein's theory of relativity changed our understanding of time and space.

words.zh: n. 公式，方程式；配方；准则，方案；方法；配方奶粉；套话；【数】公式
words.example: We used the chemical formula to balance the equation in class.

words.zh: n. 天才；天资，天赋；才华
words.example: Marie Curie was a genius who devoted her life to science.

words.zh: adj. 温柔的，文雅的；温和的；平缓的；【化】温和的，缓慢的
words.example: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice to calm the worried patient.

words.zh: v. 取得专利权；  n. 专利；  adj. 显然的，明显的；专利的；有专利的
words.example: She decided to patent her new invention immediately.

words.zh: n. 强烈的情感，激情；酷爱；盛怒，激愤
words.example: Her passion for physics inspired many young students to study science.

words.zh: n. 博士学位
words.example: She earned her doctorate in chemistry from a famous university.

words.zh: adj. 非同寻常的；特别的；意想不到的
words.example: The chemist made an extraordinary discovery that changed the history of medicine.

words.zh: adv. 逐步地；渐渐地
words.example: The temperature gradually increased as the experiment continued.

words.zh: adj. 光电的
words.example: The photoelectric effect helped scientists understand the nature of light.

words.zh: phr. 掌权；上台
words.example: After the revolution, the new leader came to power and reformed education.

words.zh: n. 机构；制度；惯例；习俗；建立，设立，制定；社团
words.example: The university is a respected institution with a long history.

words.zh: n. 学会；学院，专科学院，研究院（或所）；机构建筑；机构；  vt. 建立，设立，制定
words.example: She works at a research institute studying climate change.

words.zh: n. 结果；后果；重要性
words.example: Every scientific decision has a consequence that must be considered carefully.

words.zh: phr. 担任；任职
words.example: After finishing his studies, he took up a position at the university.

words.zh: n. 小胡子，髭（mustache）；（哺乳动物的）触须
words.example: The history teacher has a thick moustache and a warm smile.

words.zh: n. 怪癖；独特性；个性
words.example: One peculiarity of this language is its unusual word order.

words.zh: vt. 邂逅，偶遇；遭遇；  n. 偶然碰见；遭遇；相遇，邂逅
words.example: During the field trip, we encountered a rare bird in the forest.

words.zh: n. 教授；高级教师
words.example: The professor explained the difficult concept with simple examples.

words.zh: v. 哀悼，哀伤
words.example: The whole nation gathered to mourn the loss of the great scientist.

words.zh: adj. 卓越的；聪颖的；明亮的；漂亮的；极好的；才华横溢的
words.example: Her brilliant idea solved the problem that had puzzled us for weeks.

words.zh: adj. 显著的，非凡的，卓越的
words.example: The young athlete showed remarkable courage during the final competition.

words.zh: n. 装置，设备；手段，计谋；方法；技巧；【计】设备
words.example: This small device can measure the temperature of the water instantly.

words.zh: v. 共计；总结；概括；  n. 全部，总和；算术；款项，金额；【数】总和
words.example: Please sum the numbers on the board and write the total.

words.zh: phr. 总结；概括
words.example: At the end of the report, the author summed up the main findings.

words.zh: n. 气流；通风，通风装置；草稿；汇票；征兵；草案；初步计划；  v. 起草；草拟；征兵；计划；  adj. 草拟的；（啤酒）散装的；（动物）驮重物的，负重的
words.example: I need to draft a speech for the school assembly tomorrow.
